description:
REAR GARDEN

T1	Bay	20% Crown Reduction - 20% Crown Reduction - Reducing the height and spread of the tree by approximately 1-2m to tidy and contain

T4	Holly (Ilex aquifolium)	Reduce crown by around 0.5-1m all round, to shape and tidy and encourage growth. Final height 8m and final spread 6m

FRONT GARDEN		

T5	Holm Oak - Evergreen Oak (Quercus ilex)	20% Crown Reduction - Reducing the height and spread of the tree by approximately 1.5-2m, to previous reduction points, to tidy and contain. Final height = 10m and final spread = 8m.
